title: Search for everyone
author: elashri
relevanceReason: 命中 1 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: Nov 5th, 2026 - Your friends and family can finally try Kagi #
As many of you know, we don't run ads anywhere. Instead, we are active on social media and online communities to stay close to you, build a great product, and rely on word of mouth.

We've heard that it can be hard to recommend a search engine when your friends can't try it without creating an account. That's changed: anyone, anywhere, can now visit kagi.com and search the web. No account required for the first 50 searches (100 more upon registration).
summaryZh: Nov 5th, 2026 - Your friends and family can finally try Kagi #

comments.author: Nition
comments.textRawHtml:
If anyone from Kagi is reading this: Now that you have search without an account, is there any chance we can finally get a DNS-based enforced safesearch option like every other major search engine has? It's been in the feedback requests since May 2022[1].

Anyone on an enforced-safesearch network can now go to kagi.com, turn SafeSearch off, and search for porn or anything else, which is just going to get kagi blocked completely on all those networks. If you add a SafeSearch-enforced alternative IP address, then Kagi can still be used.

[1] https://kagifeedback.org/d/3285-safe-search-dns-locking-for-...

children.author: Nition
children.textRawHtml:
It can be useful at home for parents with kids as well. A decent number of people use Pi-hole, NextDNS, or some other DNS blocker service.

Either way, ultimately the result of not offering the option will more likely be getting blocked entirely, than workers being freed from the shackles of SafeSearch.

Also blocking the search is pretty weird, what prevents me of typing the URL directly?

children.author: selcuka
children.textRawHtml:
> Anyone can change their DNS and use DNS over https

Not if the machine is locked down. Blocking all search engines is not a feasible approach, though, hence the Safe Search mechanism.

> Also blocking the search is pretty weird, what prevents me of typing the URL directly?

That URL can be blocked at the router level, but one can still see cached search engine images when safe search is off.
